src.gen: A grand mansion ballroom at night, well-dressed guests in dark suits and evening gowns mingling near tall windows, a server carrying a tray of drinks, crystal chandeliers glowing overhead
src.move: a server weaves through the crowd with a tray of champagne glasses while guests turn and chat in small circles

src.gen: Inside a polished hotel elevator at night, three businessmen in dark suits standing together as a fourth man in a suit steps in through the sliding doors and reaches to shake hands
src.move: the elevator doors slide open, the man steps inside and extends his hand toward the group

src.gen: Close view inside a hotel elevator of an older wealthy businessman in a tailored suit, his eyes wide and mouth open in astonishment as he stares across at another man
src.move: the astonished man slowly shakes his head in disbelief, his eyebrows raised

src.gen: An elegant dinner table set for two in a grand dining room at night, tall windows behind them overlooking a harbor filled with glowing yacht lights, candles and fine china on the tablecloth
src.move: a hand lifts a wine glass to toast across the table as the harbor lights glimmer through the window behind them
